purpose: Name the three neighboring scene-resource rebuild bytes that control per-phase delay, wait release, and phase finalization.

states.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_REBUILD_PHASE_DELAY
states.initialize: 0x001B1830 derives 0x0A from SCENE_RESOURCE_REBUILD_PHASE_COUNTER; 0x001B19B8 reloads 0x3C after phase finalization.
states.consume: 0x001B1850 decrements it while SCENE_RESOURCE_REBUILD_WAIT_GATE is clear.

states.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_REBUILD_WAIT_GATE
states.initialize: 0x001B183C sets it before the repeated service loop.
states.clear: 0x001B195C clears it after the Z80 status-bit-4 completion path.

states.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_REBUILD_PHASE_PENDING
states.set: 0x001B18B2 sets it after the phase delay expires and phase work is prepared.
states.consume: 0x001B1966 tests it to select phase finalization.

conclusion: FFF121, FFF120, and FFF11E are the scene-resource rebuild's per-phase delay, wait-release gate, and one-shot phase-pending marker; all three have accesses confined to SceneResource_RebuildAfterInteraction.
